companyProfile.companyDescription: Adani Enterprises Limited is an India-based integrated infrastructure company that operates with various businesses spanning across integrated resource management, mining services and commercial mining, new energy ecosystem, data center, airports, roads, copper, digital, food Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) and others. Its segments include integrated resources management, mining services, commercial mining, new energy ecosystem, airport, road, and others. The Integrated Resources Management provides end-to-end procurement and logistics services. The Mining segment includes mining service contracts for nine coal blocks with a capacity of approximately 100 plus millinewton (Mn) metric tons per annum. The Airport segment is engaged in the construction, operations, and maintenance of airports. The New Energy Ecosystem provides cell and module manufacturing. The Road segment is engaged in the construction, operations, and maintenance of road assets. It also operates in duty free business.

recentNews.headline: How Adani Group stocks are performing today after share prices plunged yesterday | Top gainers and losers
recentNews.summary: Adani Group stocks showed mixed performance as Adani Green Energy rose over 4%, while Adani Enterprises volatilely dropped. The MSCI index reshuffle continues to influence stock movements, with significant fund inflows expected for several companies.

recentNews.headline: Adani Power, Adani Enterprises to Adani Energy: Gautam Adani-owned stocks crash up to 8% in trade today; here's why
recentNews.summary: Adani Group stocks faced significant selling pressure on Monday amidst MSCI index reshuffling. Adani Enterprises dropped over 8%, with all major group companies declining. Broader Indian markets also weakened, reflecting caution among investors before MSCI changes and external economic pressures.

recentNews.headline: MSCI Rejig: Adani Energy, Lenskart, Groww to see inflows; Reliance weight trimmed
recentNews.summary: The MSCI index reshuffle will highlight several Indian stocks as portfolio adjustments take effect on September 1. This could lead to increased trading volume and volatility, especially in low liquidity stocks, marking the first major test of India's new closing auction system.

recentNews.headline: Adani Enterprises: Rich valuations and holding-company discount risk may cap gains
recentNews.summary: Brokerages see further upside in AEL, but their targets already bake in steep premiums for its airports, new-energy and data-centre businesses, leaving earnings growth to do the heavy lifting.

recentNews.headline: Buy or sell: Gift Nifty signals big gap-up start | Vaishali Parekh recommends three stocks to buy today — 28 August 2026
recentNews.summary: Buy or sell indicator: Gift Nifty live chart signals a big gap-up opening, as the index is trading over 150 points above yesterday's spot Nifty 50 close of 24,090

recentNews.headline: Inside Google’s Vizag data centre: fast approval, GPS for fishermen, AI corridor
recentNews.summary: Google’s $15 billion, 1GW Vizag data centre is set to anchor an emerging AI corridor in India. Backed by Adani and Airtel, the project benefited from fast approvals and could bring more tech firms to the region, with the first phase expected by mid-2028.

recentNews.headline: Stock market prediction tomorrow, 28 August: What to expect from Sensex, Nifty, Hang Seng, KOSPI, Nikkei on Friday
recentNews.summary: The Sensex ended 539 points, or 0.70%, lower at 76,933.59, while the Nifty 50 closed the day at 24,090.85, down 117 points, or 0.48%.

recentNews.headline: Adani, GMR increase bets on non-aero revenue to drive growth
recentNews.summary: Major airport developers, Adani and GMR, are aggressively expanding retail, dining, and commercial offerings to drive profitability as passenger traffic growth cools down.

recentNews.headline: Raja Venkatraman recommends three stocks for 26 August
recentNews.summary: Market expert Raja Venkatraman shares his top stock picks for 26 August. Here’s his technical outlook and trade strategy.

recentNews.headline: Top Gainers & Losers on 25 Aug: FACT, Vodafone Idea, Cyient, Paytm, Angel One, Pine Labs among top gainers
recentNews.summary: The Indian stock market recovered by close on August 25, buoyed by late buying; Nifty 50 gained 0.17% and Sensex 0.21%. Despite gains, market sentiment stayed fragile amid heightened tensions related to U.S. sanctions on Iran.
